items.check: invisible_knowledge carries the non-recoverable knowledge from the planning session (system, invariants, tradeoffs all populated)
The byte-preserving write invariant (reconnection changes only LOCATION/PRIMARYKEY attribute values, every other byte identical) is recorded as an invariant
The one-to-one assignment invariant and the fact that match_records detects only source-side ambiguity (not destination collisions) is recorded as an invariant
The old-side-gating rationale for fingerprinting (old media is exactly what may be unreachable, which is why reconnection exists) is recorded
The accepted v1 scope boundary (flat playlist-entry merge/subset, not playlist-tree preservation; no smartlist criteria; no SORTING_ORDER beyond append order) is recorded as a tradeoff
The system field describes the NML domain model (LOCATION VOLUME/VOLUMEID/DIR/FILE on COLLECTION entries; PRIMARYKEY as flattened reference from PLAYLIST entries) rather than being empty
planning_context.constraints records the constraints established in the planning session rather than being empty

The seven MUST-class constraints (byte-preserving writes, never-silently-guess, one-to-one assignment, explicit VOLUME/VOLUMEID, splice fail-on-conflict with persistent report, dry-run-before-write and refuse output==input, zero-write-on-ambiguity/error) are each recorded
The two SHOULD-class constraints (reuse existing abstractions; follow existing CLI conventions) are recorded
planning_context.risks is populated and each recorded risk carries a mitigation
Architectural assumptions carried from the planning session are recorded with their confidence and validation path
The assumption that schema verification covers only VERSION=20 / Traktor Pro 4, with other versions unverified, is recorded
The assumption that mutagen and pyacoustid/fpcalc are acceptable new optional dependencies is recorded
The M-confidence assumption that Traktor tolerates a freshly generated UUID on a renamed imported playlist is recorded together with its manual-validation requirement
The alternatives considered and rejected during planning are recorded so a future maintainer does not re-litigate them
The fingerprint numeric thresholds (duration tolerance 1.0s, match above 0.95, review band 0.80-0.95) have a logged rationale for those specific values
The fresh-UUID-on-renamed-playlist behaviour is backed by a recorded assumption or risk rather than asserted as a bare requirement
The single-schema-version basis of every structural guarantee is visible in the plan as a risk with a stated mitigation
overview.approach states the strategy connecting the eight milestones rather than being empty
Milestone ordering dependencies (M-002 before all implementation, M-006 before M-007 and M-008) are expressed rather than left implicit in the number field
Each decision's reasoning is a full chain (premise, implication, resolution) rather than a bare assertion
No diagram node lacks edges and no edge references a missing node
Every decision_ref resolves to an existing decision id
No milestone is an orphan lacking code_intents
